judged_text: In sync mode zohoCrmTokenInfo is a raw fetch Response with no .data property, so the unchanged guard if (!zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error) dereferences undefined. With credential sync enabled, every zohocrm token refresh throws a TypeError ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading error)') and the refresh fails; non-sync mode still works because the axios response has .data.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in diff: `refreshOAuthTokens` returns a raw `fetch(...)` Response object when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` (packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts). In Zoho CRM refresh, the code assigns `const zohoCrmTokenInfo = await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` and then immediately accesses `zohoCrmTokenInfo.data.error` (packages/app-store/zohocrm/lib/CalendarService.ts). A fetch Response has no `.data` property, so in sync mode this will dereference `undefined` and throw a TypeError, breaking token refresh. Non-sync mode still returns the axios response (with `.data`), matching the finding.
